prototype.title: Yamba's mangoes
prototype.intro: Help Yamba organize the 24 mangoes. This demonstration checks selection, movement, counting and correction without imposing a new lesson.
prototype.yamba: Choose a mango, then choose the basket where you want to place it. You can also take it back to correct your choice.
prototype.catalogIntro: The objects are independent from the backgrounds and can be reused in the market, the school shop and future adventures.

mango.title: Share the mangoes
mango.instruction: Select a mango, then choose a basket. With a mouse, you can also drag it.

orange.title: Sharing the oranges
orange.instruction: Select an orange, then choose a table's basket. You can take it back to correct your work.
